Subject: MAP: MSA/DPA redlines process & owners — next steps

Hi Lauren / Peter — thanks again for today's call. Quick recap + a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the legal milestone so we can keep momentum toward the target close date (see proposed timeline below). Please review and flag any owner/TAT changes.

High-level recap
- Scope: host Redwood Inference (hosted + dedicated) for customer-facing inference workloads; expected initial throughput profile outlined in the POC doc.
- Key blockers we agreed to: MSA redlines + DPA alignment, SOC 2 evidence for security team, procurement PO & billing terms.

Draft MAP (legal milestone emphasis)
1) MSA redlines (owner & process) — Owner: Customer Legal (Peter) + Redwood Legal (Marcus).
   - Requested action: Customer to send initial redlines (editable .docx).
   - Redwood response target: initial consolidated comments within 2 business days after receipt.
   - Escalation: If commercial terms change materially, schedule legal sync within 48 hours.
2) DPA review & data security clauses — Owner: Redwood (Neha) + Customer Legal.
   - Target TAT: 3 business days for initial alignment on data categories and retention.
3) SLA & availability language — Owner: Redwood Product + Marcus for legal framing.
   - Align on service credits wording during redline pass.
4) Procurement & PO issuance — Owner: Lauren (Customer)
   - Dependency: PO required for Dedicated capacity onboarding; target PO delivery by 2026-05-20.
5) Technical POC acceptance — Owner: Vanessa / Redwood Eng
   - Acceptance criteria documented in MAP spreadsheet (attached).

Target close date: 2026-06-04
Dependencies that may push timeline
- Procurement lead time (PO issuance)
- Unanticipated SOC 2 gaps or additional security questionnaires
- Material commercial changes in MSA

Next steps (today)
- Peter: please send your initial redline file and confirm preferred TAT for your legal team (we propose 3–5 business days).
- Marcus: will own Redwood's legal consolidation and publish a single redline pass back to you.
- Neha: will prepare current SOC 2 snapshot and DPA template for your review.
- Vanessa: will update the MAP spreadsheet and post to the shared Drive.

Attachments: nimbus_map_v0.3.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks — looking forward to keeping pace.

Best,

- DPA/Security: Neha will drop the current DPA template and SOC 2 snapshot to this thread within 24 hours.

I attached our redline-guidelines.md (internal) to make turnaround predictable. For tracking, Vanessa — can you post the MAP v0.3 and invite both legal threads to the doc?
